paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: God's house is for prayer, and it's for everybody. Jesus says, "My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations" (Mark 11:17). That is a HUGE guest list, and I'd have to bake a lot of cookies to cover it. Jesus cared enough about it to overturn tables (Mark 11:15).

Then Peter points at a withered tree, and Jesus answers with four words: "Have faith in God" (Mark 11:22). He goes on to say, "whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours" (Mark 11:24). I put my faith in my mixer once, and that mixer humbled me. So Jesus says to put it in God, and that is where your prayers belong.

Jesus isn't done, because He adds one more thing for when you stand to pray. He says, "if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well" (Mark 11:25). Holding a grudge is like carrying a hot tray with no mitts, friend, and it only hurts YOU. So when you pray, set it down.
